name: Lavender Levitate - Natural Epsom & Lavender Bath Salts for Relaxation
description:
Some days your body just needs to dissolve into warm water and let go.

Lavender Levitate is a natural epsom and lavender bath salt blend - magnesium-rich, coconut oil-nourished and topped with real dried lavender buds - designed to relax muscles, relieve stress, soften skin and help you sleep better. A complete self-care ritual in one glass jar.

Epsom salt (Magnesium Sulphate) is the workhorse. Magnesium absorbed transdermally through warm water promotes genuine muscle relaxation - easing tension, soothing cramps and relieving the stiffness that builds up through the day. Particularly effective after workouts, long sitting hours or any day that just feels heavy.

Sea salt (Sodium Chloride) improves circulation and helps draw out impurities - leaving skin feeling genuinely refreshed rather than just clean.

Coconut oil - rich in fatty acids - moisturises and softens skin as you soak so you step out feeling nourished not just relaxed.

Lavender essential oil is clinically associated with reduced anxiety and improved sleep quality. Its calming aroma works on the nervous system as the salts work on the body - a genuinely complete wind-down experience.

Dried lavender buds float through your water creating a spa-like visual and aromatherapeutic experience that no synthetic bath product can replicate.

Three ways to use it - bath, bucket bath or foot soak.

100g. Made in India.
ingredients: Magnesium sulphate (Epsom salt), Sodium chloride, Cocos nucifera (Coconut) oil, Lavandula angustifolia (Lavender) essential oil, Lavender buds

name: Neel Rajwada Double Bedsheet
description:
The Moomal Mahal Jogi Patchwork Bedcover is an exquisite expression of Rajasthan’s nomadic textile heritage. Drawing from the vibrant craft traditions of the Jogi communities, each king-size bedcover is a celebration of color, movement, and generations of artisan mastery.

Skilled craftspeople assemble carefully selected the fabric panels into a striking patchwork composition, then layer and stitch them with intricate hand embroidery techniques passed down through the Jogi artisan lineage. The luminous quality of fabric elevates each color — rich magentas, deep indigos, warm ambers — creating a bedcover of extraordinary visual depth and tactile luxury.

Key Features:

  • Jogi Craft Heritage: Handcrafted using traditional patchwork techniques from Rajasthan’s nomadic Jogi artisan communities.
  • Vibrant Patchwork: Carefully curated panels in jewel-toned hues create a striking visual composition.
  • King Size: Generous 108×88 inch dimensions for full bed coverage with elegant drape.
  • One of a Kind: Each piece carries unique variations — the unmistakable signature of human hands.
  • Supports Artisan Communities: Every purchase sustains the livelihoods of Jogi artisan families.

Specifications:

  • Material: Cotton
  • Technique: Jogi Patchwork
  • Size: 108inch × 88inch (King Size / Double Bed)
